findings.issue: Periphery around a target that is not getting closer: Lane A.1 target 1 is `W^{k,p}(Ω)` with completeness, spelled order-indexed in the roadmap's own sketch (`Wkp 1 2 Ω`). `W1p` and `W2p` are already on main citing that target (W2p.lean:41, "the second-order case of Lane A.1, target 1"); this PR adds a third fixed order with a full parallel API (secondOrder/thirdDerivative projections, mk, ext, four norm bounds, p=2 sum-of-squares) that the eventual `Wkp` will subsume, and which — with no compatibility layer — will simply be deleted then. No in-repo consumer needs order three (grep: `W3p` occurs only in W3p.lean; `W2p` only in GraphStep/W2p/W3p).

summary: The GraphStep extraction is a genuine Lane A.1 prerequisite and a single coherent topic with its two specializations, but W3p is a third hand-rolled fixed-order space citing the same target as the already-merged W1p and W2p, and it leaves the order-indexed W^{k,p} no closer. Justify order three by a downstream need, or land the successor step and go to the k-indexed construction.
